retrievalProfile.description: A vibrant ensemble-based layout featuring a group of young adults against a bright blue sky with iconic landmarks and bold, centered title graphics.
triggerTerms: bright blue sky background with landmarks
excludeWhen: dark or moody themes are requested

recipe.visualDefinition: A group of five young adults in casual, colorful clothing (orange, green, red, maroon) are clustered on the left, looking toward the viewer. The background is a bright, slightly hazy blue sky transitioning to a low-horizon cityscape featuring miniature iconic European landmarks like the Eiffel Tower and Big Ben. A prominent title bar sits at the bottom center, styled like a road sign.
coreVisualRelationships: Ensemble cast clustered on the left third of the frame
Iconic landmarks scaled down and placed on the right horizon
Bold title graphic anchored at the bottom center
Text blocks balanced in the upper right and top horizontal bar
coreInvariants: Primary and secondary color palette in clothing

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Subjects occupy the left 60% of the frame, scaled from waist-up to full torso.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The rectangular title block at the bottom center acts as the primary anchor.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes start at the pointing finger of the subject in green, move down to the central group, then right to the landmarks and text.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Open blue sky in the upper right quadrant provides breathing room for secondary text.

colorSystem.accentColorRole: Vibrant orange and red (clothing and title accents)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation and high value across all elements for a cheerful, energetic tone.

characterSpecificRedesigns: Title 'O' replaced with a circular 'No Parking' style road sign icon

composition.relationshipToImage: contained within a white rectangular box with a blue border

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Bold display sans-serif for the title paired with a cleaner, more legible sans-serif for secondary information.
graphicDevices: Subtle drop shadows on floating text

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the weight and geometric feel of the title text.
Appropriate for the humanist sans-serif metadata text.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a bright blue sky with soft white clouds. On the left, place a group of 5 smiling young adults in colorful 2000s casual wear. On the right horizon, place small, slightly hazy icons of the Eiffel Tower, Leaning Tower of Pisa, and Big Ben.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a white rectangular bar at the top with wide-tracked white sans-serif text. Place a large white box at the bottom center containing bold red/orange sans-serif text, replacing one letter with a red 'No Parking' circle-slash symbol.

verificationChecks: Is the sky a vibrant blue?
Is the title text bold and centered in a box?
Are the landmarks visible but secondary to the people?
Is the 'No Parking' symbol integrated into the title?

adjustableVariables: Number of people in the ensemble
Color of the title text gradient
postGenerationChecks: Ensure the title box is perfectly centered at the bottom.
Verify that the sky color is consistent and bright.
Check that the text in the top bar is evenly spaced.
Confirm the ensemble cast looks cohesive and cheerful.
recipe.reuseFormula: Ensemble cast on left + blue sky background + miniature landmarks on right + road-sign inspired title block at bottom center.
